decks.notes: This deck focuses on using powerful graveyard synergy to quickly bring back big creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Reanimate, Entomb, and Animate Dead. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces, as well as disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The main goal is to quickly and efficiently reanimate threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find key pieces.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Molten Collapse, and countermagic like Force of Will. The deck also relies on card advantage engines like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to outvalue the opponent. In addition, the deck utilizes efficient threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Thundertrap Trainer to apply pressure and close out the game. The mana base consists of various fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistency in casting spells of all colors.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent through the synergy between Lands and Control elements. With cards like Dark Depths, Thespian's Stage, and Life from the Loam, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own powerful board presence. Utilizing cards like Wasteland and Boseiju, Who Endures, the deck can also protect its key pieces while slowly grinding the opponent down. By efficiently managing resources and utilizing various land-based strategies, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent over the course of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creature cards using cards like Entomb and Cling to Dust, then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. The deck aims to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and control the game. Additionally, cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Murktide Regent provide card advantage and additional threats.

The key concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base and play aggressive threats such as Magus of the Moon and Fury. By locking down lands with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to control the game and win through heavy-hitting creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Sundering Eruption to deal with threats and close out the game. The high amount of mana acceleration and disruptive elements make this deck a formidable and fast-paced aggro strategy in the Legacy format.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient spells and creatures to apply constant pressure on the opponent. By running a combination of powerful instant and sorcery spells alongside aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, it aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly reducing their life total. With a suite of disruptive spells like Stifle and Force of Will, along with land destruction tools like Wasteland, this deck aims to control the game tempo and close out matches before the opponent has a chance to recover.

The deck focuses on casting low-cost spells to keep up tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It looks to control the board by countering key spells while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. The use of cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm help filter through the deck to find the right answers quickly. By combining disruption with aggressive creatures, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of efficient creature threats, counter spells, and removal. The deck focuses on applying pressure early with cheap, aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, while also having access to powerful disruptive spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Spell Pierce to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes card advantage engines like Mishra's Bauble and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to maintain momentum and out-value the opponent.

The deck relies on a combination of early disruption and efficient creatures to control the tempo of the game. By leveraging cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Dauthi Voidwalker, the deck aims to apply pressure and force the opponent into a reactive position. The inclusion of powerful spells like Brainstorm and Ponder allow the player to stay ahead on card advantage and make informed decisions throughout the game, ultimately leading to a victory through attrition and calculated aggression.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bring them back onto the battlefield for a devastating combo. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo, along with versatile cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection. The inclusion of cards like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent gives the deck multiple threats to choose from when reanimating. The deck also includes a toolbox of versatile threats and answers to adapt to different matchups and situations, allowing for a diverse range of strategies to be employed.

This Legacy Canadian Threshold deck focuses on aggressive play with efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler backed up by disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Wasteland and Lightning Bolt while maintaining card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. Murktide Regent provides a powerful late-game threat, while cards like Unholy Heat and Thundering Falls help deal with problematic creatures and threats. The deck's mana base is streamlined to support its aggressive gameplay.

The main concept of this Legacy UR Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes various cheap, efficient spells like Force of Will, Daze, Lightning Bolt, and Counterspells to control the board and protect its threats. Cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent provide a fast clock, forcing the opponent to react quickly or risk falling behind.
